product_updates.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
product_updates.content: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

product_updates.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
product_updates.content: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

product_updates.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
product_updates.content: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

product_updates.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
product_updates.content: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

product_updates.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
product_updates.content: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

product_updates.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
product_updates.content: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

product_updates.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
product_updates.content: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

product_updates.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
product_updates.content: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

product_updates.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
product_updates.content: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

product_updates.title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
product_updates.content: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
technical_breakthroughs.content: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.
